verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is itself an official first-party Python SDK. It offers a typed Agent API generic over dependency and output types, function tools via decorators, structured outputs, message history, multi-agent primitives, durable execution, and TestModel/FunctionModel for testing. Community developers report building production agents and integrations on it and call its public API easy to extend, though one notes the lower-level APIs are painful. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond Python, smoother lower-level APIs.
